npcs.name: Irma Velvetglass
npcs.description: Irma Velvetglass is a Celestial Elf memory-den host who dresses grief in velvet, candlelight, perfume, and plausible deniability. She offers curated recollection rituals, dream seats, old love reenactments, and supervised ichor-adjacent memory treatments to people who can pay or who are broken enough that someone else pays for them. Irma is theatrical, warm, and business-minded, but she knows nostalgia becomes a narcotic when the present hurts too much to inhabit.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Faelvyrûn is a Town in Iazethas, under Triumvirate, with low danger, Partial forest, Deep forest, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Celestial Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Celestial Elf. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Irma can tell whether a client wants healing, escape, or punishment by how they sit before the memory chair warms.
A magistrate visits her den monthly to remember a crime they officially never witnessed.
plotHooks: Irma hires the party after a client's purchased memory begins spreading to other visitors.
A missing agent left their last real recollection in Irma's care, but opening it may expose half the district.
